transcript.text: During my review of the patent chain-of-title file, I confirmed that a prior agreement grants a university consortium continuing rights to conduct non-commercial research with the diagnostic platform. The current draft's grant of worldwide exclusivity to Helixion would conflict with that existing agreement unless we expressly reserve those non-commercial research rights for the university consortium. I have this documented in my working file but have not yet circulated a revised license comment. I recommend that the license be modified to include an express reservation of the consortium's non-commercial research rights before it goes to executive approval.

transcript.text: During this week's business call with Helixion, I confirmed that their planned deployment model depends on sublicensing the platform only to accredited hospitals, not to unrestricted commercial partners. I have not yet added this term to the deal-summary spreadsheet, but it needs to be incorporated into the license before executive approval.

transcript.text: My export-control review found that the platform's controlled technical documentation falls under ECCN 3E001. Because of that classification, the license must prohibit transfers to embargoed jurisdictions and require an end-user certificate before any controlled technical documentation is transferred. I have this documented in export-control's working folder, but it has not yet been incorporated into the draft. These two requirements need to be added to the license before executive approval.
